reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in our DM. I told them I'll keep the possible ticket change to #7917 (for the West yard Door 2 double-booking at Marrow Fieldworks) between the two of us. I won't repeat it in any channel or to anyone else, and I'll only use a new number once it's confirmed somewhere the team can see.

I didn't save the number to GBrain or anywhere else, because that would have spread something they asked me to keep in this DM. I checked GBrain first, and it had nothing about this ticket. Its search was running in a limited keyword-only mode, though, so that doesn't prove it holds nothing.
